prompt: The paper is in /work/papers/moe_eviction.txt. In the experiment where the router is fine-tuned with GRPO for cache hits (Appendix E), how many steady expert transfers do the untuned base model and the model trained with the cache-hit reward make under lossless serving with decayed-frequency (LFU) eviction, at the main operating point (8 restricted layers, C=32)? Give the answer and, as evidence, an exact quote from the paper.

reference.answer: With LRU + LFU eviction, the untuned base makes 27,275 steady transfers and the cache-hit-reward model 27,355.
